title: cf-chip — a classification label with no colour channel, and why cf-badge cannot take the job

findings.method: checked = the 10 contrast pairs in the payload's measurement table, each computed from design-system/tokens/tokens.json release 0.2.0 by resolving the alias chain to a hex and applying WCAG relative luminance (Y = 0.2126R + 0.7152G + 0.0722B on linearised sRGB), ratio = (Yl + 0.05) / (Yd + 0.05), all re-derived on demand by verify-contrast.py in this directory at a tolerance of 0.002. found = 3: (1) cf-badge's four kinds are separated by HUE ONLY — semantic.support.error 4.235:1, .success 4.246:1 and .warning 4.221:1 against palette.bone.default are within 0.025 of each other and therefore luminance-identical (#da1e28 Y=0.159872, #198038 Y=0.159305, #8e6a00 Y=0.160589), so a badge reading 'error' and a badge reading 'success' are indistinguishable in greyscale, in monochrome print, and to a reader with deuteranopia or protanopia — cf-badge cannot reliably carry the four meanings it already has, which is a stronger reason not to extend it than the reserved-scale argument the dispatch supplied; (2) three of those four also fail the 4.5:1 SC 1.4.3 text floor on bone, so a badge LABEL set in semantic.support.error is non-conforming; (3) release 0.2.0 has no radius axis and gate-b.py blocks 'border-radius: <n>px' as raw spacing, so a rounded chip is not expressible on-token at all and the component ships square-cornered by constraint rather than by choice. skipped = 3 checks not run and claimed in neither direction: no render was produced; no screen-reader pass; no forced-colors or greyscale render — the greyscale claim above is derived from measured luminance, which is the correct instrument for it, but no image was produced. Skipped is not passed.

notes.this_is_a_proposal: Nothing here is in design-system/component-index.json and this artifact did not write to it. Promotion is explicit human approval recorded as an ADR (CLAUDE.md, 'The membrane') and screen-producer cannot perform it.
notes.two_proposals_in_one_artifact: This payload carries a SECOND proposal — an amendment to the existing cf-badge entry's when_not_to_use and a11y.note. cf-badge is a stable entry that screen-producer does not own and did not edit. The two proposals need separate approvals and separate ADRs; approving cf-chip does not approve the cf-badge amendment. They are filed together because the amendment is only legible next to the measurement that motivates it, and splitting them would have produced an amendment nobody could evaluate.
notes.why_a_new_workstream: design-system-authoring did not exist. brand-foundations is the brand and its tokens, design-system-selection is which vendor system to adopt, luma-travel is a client research thread, system-operations is the operating cost of the agent apparatus. A proposal to enter component-index.json is none of those and outlives the board that prompted it. Same reasoning ART-010 recorded when it created system-operations.
